_comment: Moldura canônica ARKLAND para ícones AI de espécies — baseada em generated/carno.webp. Usado por tools/generate_ai_species_icons.py.

outer_frame.edge_style: beveled with silver highlights upper-left, shadow lower-right
outer_frame.texture: subtle scratches, scuffs, industrial survival aesthetic
outer_frame.corner_details: diagonal corner notches — four joined metal segments

portrait_inset.description: Solid dark navy — no scenery, no gradients beyond rim light on creature

ark_logo.style: ARK Survival Evolved official-style logo, small, legible at 256px

creature_name.font_style: bold condensed sans-serif, all-caps or title case matching display_name
creature_name.shadow: subtle dark drop shadow for legibility on metal

C.label: Entrada
C.description_pt: Mais acessível na loja, stats ainda relevantes

reference_policy.creature_reference: refs/species_icons/{species_key}.png — anatomy/silhouette ONLY inside portrait inset
reference_policy.frame_reference: refs/species_icons/_frame_template_carno.png — frame layout ONLY; do NOT copy creature from frame template
reference_policy.never: Do not use creature reference images for frame geometry or tier badge placement

prompt_rules: IDENTICAL frame layout for every species — only tier badge letter and creature name text change
Creature bust/portrait inside inset; reference image guides anatomy only
ARK logo + display name + tier badge are mandatory on every icon
Do not omit frame, badge, or name even if reference image is plain black background
RECOMMENDED: creature_bust_prompt + composite_standard_icon() (PIL) — mais confiável que IA desenhar a moldura
